answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. Each agent locks 40 units, and only a fingerprint of verified work reaching the zenith tier unlocks rights. A velvet rope lifts only for matching new work, so copies fail. The harbor shelters only matching agents: one honest identity pays once and earns undiluted rewards. Forging 100 identities needs 100 deposits and 100 histories, 4000 units plus months of work, far above any stolen reward.
